subject: Economics
description: Planning Commission, NITI Aayog, 5-year plans, key economists

questions.stem: India's FIRST Five-Year Plan (1951-56) focused mainly on:
questions.explanation: 1st FYP (1951-56) — based on Harrod-Domar model. Focus: agriculture and irrigation (Bhakra Nangal, DVC). PM Nehru was plan chairman. Target growth: 2.1%; achieved: 3.6%. Planning Commission was created in 1950 (non-statutory body).
questions.subject: Economics

questions.stem: The SECOND Five-Year Plan (1956-61) was designed around the:
questions.explanation: 2nd FYP (1956-61) — based on the Mahalanobis (P.C. Mahalanobis) model emphasising rapid industrialisation, especially heavy industries. Led to setup of public-sector steel plants at Bhilai, Rourkela, Durgapur. Nehru-Mahalanobis strategy.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.stem: The PLANNING COMMISSION was REPLACED by NITI Aayog on:
questions.explanation: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India) set up 1 January 2015 by Cabinet resolution. PM is ex-officio Chair. First Vice-Chair: Arvind Panagariya; now Suman Bery (from 2022). Policy think-tank, NOT a fund-allocation body.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.stem: The LAST Five-Year Plan of India was the:
questions.explanation: 12th FYP (2012-2017) — last five-year plan. Theme: 'Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth'. After NITI Aayog replaced Planning Commission (2015), the 5-year-plan framework was replaced with a 3-year Action Agenda (2017-2020), 7-year Strategy, and 15-year Vision document.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.stem: The 'GOLDEN QUADRILATERAL' highway project aims to connect:
questions.explanation: GQ — National Highway project connecting Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata (~6,000 km). Initiated by NHAI under Vajpayee's NDA government (1998-99). Completed 2012. Reduced travel times + freight costs significantly. Part of NHDP (National Highways Development Project).
questions.subject: Economics

questions.stem: The concept of 'GARIBI HATAO' was a central slogan of which PLAN?
questions.explanation: 5th FYP (1974-79) — 'Garibi Hatao' ('Remove Poverty') was its central theme, coined during Indira Gandhi's 1971 election campaign. Emphasis on employment, poverty alleviation. Also Minimum Needs Programme (MNP). Terminated early by Janata government in 1978, 1 year ahead.
questions.subject: Economics

questions.stem: PLANNING COMMISSION was set up under the chairmanship of:
questions.explanation: Planning Commission — set up 15 March 1950 by a Cabinet resolution. PM ex-officio Chairperson. Nehru as first chair. Gulzarilal Nanda — first deputy chairman. Mahalanobis — statistician (designed 2nd plan model). Montek Singh Ahluwalia — longest-serving deputy chair (2004-14).
